source.name: VfL Wolfsburg - Automotive Technology Meets Team Spirit - A Vision for the Future
source.quote: the Mobileye logo will feature on the left sleeve of VfL Wolfsburg’s kits starting with the 2025/2026 season

note: Left-sleeve sponsor in all competitions; end date and value not disclosed. Mobileye was named one of the club's three most visible partners, alongside Volkswagen and Nike.
